metadata.description: Ground truth for evaluation log containing 8 distinct incident scenarios plus normal operations
metadata.notes: This ground truth was created based on the known synthetic log generation scenarios, NOT inferred from model predictions

incidents.description: Database connection pool exhausted leading to transaction failures
incidents.expected_root_cause: Connection pool size insufficient for load, possible connection leak
incidents.expected_summary: payment-api experiencing database connection pool exhaustion with 100% utilization causing transaction failures
incidents.severity_justification: HIGH - critical service degraded, transactions failing, but not complete outage
incidents.disposition_justification: NEEDS_ONCALL - requires immediate investigation during business hours, may need connection pool scaling

incidents.description: Kafka consumer lag increased but auto-scaled and recovered
incidents.expected_root_cause: Temporary spike in email queue volume, resolved by auto-scaling
incidents.expected_summary: notification-worker experienced Kafka consumer lag up to 18000 messages, auto-scaling triggered, lag recovered
incidents.severity_justification: MEDIUM - degraded but recovering, auto-scaling working correctly

incidents.description: RabbitMQ queue backlog reached critical depth with stalled consumers and message loss risk
incidents.expected_root_cause: Consumer processing stalled, queue depth exceeded capacity, potential message loss
incidents.expected_summary: notification-worker RabbitMQ queue backlog critical with depth reaching 100k messages, consumers stalled, message loss risk detected
incidents.severity_justification: HIGH - critical queue depth, consumer stall, message loss risk
incidents.disposition_justification: NEEDS_DEV - requires code investigation for consumer stall, queue capacity planning
incidents.notes: This is a DIFFERENT incident from gt-incident-002 despite same service (different signature)

incidents.description: Stripe payment gateway completely unavailable causing payment processing blockage
incidents.expected_root_cause: Stripe API outage or network connectivity issue, cascading from payment-api issues
incidents.expected_summary: order-service unable to process payments due to Stripe gateway timeouts, payment processing completely blocked
incidents.severity_justification: CRITICAL - payment processing completely blocked, revenue impact
incidents.disposition_justification: ESCALATE - immediate on-call page required, revenue-impacting outage
incidents.notes: May be cascading failure from payment-api database issues

incidents.description: reporting-service OOM crash resulting in service unavailability
incidents.expected_root_cause: Memory leak or insufficient heap size allocation causing OOM and container termination
incidents.expected_summary: reporting-service crashed due to OutOfMemoryError, all replicas unavailable, service down
incidents.severity_justification: CRITICAL - complete service outage, 0/3 replicas ready
incidents.disposition_justification: ESCALATE - immediate on-call page, service completely down

incidents.description: Normal healthy operations - heartbeats, health checks, successful requests
incidents.expected_summary: user-service operating normally with healthy heartbeats and successful request processing
incidents.notes: This should NOT be flagged as an actionable incident - it's baseline normal activity. Note: Some clustering implementations may create multiple small incidents from this instead of one long one due to 2-minute time windows - that's acceptable.

incidents.description: Specific client exceeding rate limits causing request blocking
incidents.expected_root_cause: mobile-app-v2 client making excessive requests, possible retry loop or bug
incidents.expected_summary: auth-service rate limiter blocking mobile-app-v2 client due to excessive requests (2000/min), normalized after 3 minutes
incidents.severity_justification: MEDIUM - isolated to one client, rate limiting working correctly, self-resolved
incidents.disposition_justification: NEEDS_DEV - investigate mobile-app-v2 for retry loop or bug

incidents.description: Cache miss rate spike causing increased database latency, resolved by cache warming
incidents.expected_root_cause: Cache invalidation or expiration causing temporary miss storm, auto-remediated by cache warming
incidents.expected_summary: inventory-service cache miss storm (75% miss rate) causing database query latency increase, cache warmed and recovered
incidents.severity_justification: MEDIUM - performance degradation but self-healed via cache warming
incidents.disposition_justification: OBSERVE - self-healed, monitor cache invalidation patterns

detection.description: Model must detect all 8 distinct incidents
detection.notes: notification-worker has 2 DISTINCT incidents (Kafka lag vs RabbitMQ backlog)

severity.description: Model must correctly classify severity levels

benign_false_positive_tolerance.description: user-service normal operations should NOT be flagged as HIGH/CRITICAL

matching_rules.description: How to match predictions to ground truth incidents
rules: Prediction and ground truth must overlap in time
Prediction and ground truth must match on service
At least 50% temporal overlap required for match
Multiple predictions for same ground truth = false positives
Predictions with no ground truth match = false positives
Ground truth with no prediction match = false negatives

special_cases.notification-worker: Must distinguish Kafka lag incident from RabbitMQ incident by time windows (no temporal overlap)
